revision_reason: The completed source now exposes a separate Staff operations workspace with seeded events grouped into four readiness columns and a working combined filter area with reset and empty-state behavior. The next useful increment is a focused event detail view so staff can inspect one filtered event without losing board context, clearly compare visitor-facing information with internal preparation information, and reach the future logistics workflow. The remaining eleven-step progression is retained and continues from review into editing, checklist management, readiness control, persistence, risk detection, event creation, park-update context, and responsive use.

edit.instruction: Extend the existing Staff operations workspace without removing or replacing the visitor-facing Willowbrook page, public event cards, public event detail dialog, park news, newsletter form, about section, footer, four readiness columns, or the existing operations filters. Make each visible operations event card selectable and open a focused in-page event detail view or dialog for that event. The detail view must retain the active board filters when it is closed and must clearly separate a Visitor-facing announcement section from an Internal operations section. In the Visitor-facing section, show the selected event's existing thumbnail, title, category, date, time, location, and full description. In the Internal operations section, show its assigned responsible team member, current readiness stage, preparation progress, a logistics summary area, and any currently known preparation concerns based on the seeded event data. Include a clear Close or Back to board action that returns to the filtered operations board, and include a working Edit operations action that opens the existing event workflow entry point even if the full logistics fields are introduced in the next increment. Use the existing frontend event records and current filter state only; do not require accounts, navigation to another page, or a backend.

classification.reason: The increment adds a focused review surface that separates visitor-facing event content from internal preparation metadata and preserves the surrounding filtered board state. It is not a data table, rich text editor, wizard, or notification center.
